R1.description: An owned process first seen with an empty command line is recorded, persisted and published with its first non-empty command line; a non-empty one is never replaced (Flake 1, I1, I2)

R2.description: CrossProcessEventSeqTest and every _OrphanWorkerCase test kill the child Controller only after the worker_spawned line is in the event log; the event-log contract is unchanged (Flake 2, I3)

R3.description: InProcessConcurrencyTest starts the second step only after worker_process and worker_anchor are flushed (Flake 3)

R4.description: Each flake fix has a regression that widens its race window through a patchable seam, red against the base and green after

R5.description: A GitHub re-run of failed jobs counts: records carry their run attempt, artifacts are per attempt, and tests-result aggregates each shard's latest attempt, failing closed on ambiguity and when a job of the current attempt did not succeed, so an earlier attempt's record or plan never stands in for it (I4, I4a, I7, I9)

R6.description: A superseded attempt is reported in the summary with its verdict and failing tests, so a re-run never hides a failure; no automatic retry is added (I5, I6, Decision 2)

R7.description: A leaked process fails the run with a LEAKED verdict, and its shard's executor exits 1 so a re-run of failed jobs re-runs and can clear it (D7, I8, Decision 3)

R8.description: The guides and ADRs 0004/0005 match the new behaviour, the 1.4.2 notes are the pull request body, and the full sharded suite passes
